exposure: second trimester uterine arteries pulsatility index (UtA-PI)
cohort: The study included 82 stillbirth (SB) and 82 live-birth (LB) matched high-risk pregnancies for preeclampsia (PE) and/or fetal growth restriction (FGR).
finding: Retroplacental hematoma and distal villous hypoplasia were significantly and independently associated with stillbirth within corresponding UtA-PI MoM quartiles, and several MVM findings showed a significant correlation with UtA-PI.
